Fetched 2026-10-16. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (original PDF page 3, copyright page; page 3 is not kept in this fixture).

284 (279) Note 3 continued; 339 (334) Trust Statement narrative; 351 (346) Statement of Revenue, Other Income and Expenditure.
Every other page is a blank A4 page, so the kept pages keep their ORIGINAL PDF page numbers (the parser reads fixed page numbers).
